questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the diluted earnings per share (EPS) in conformity with US generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) reported in Salesforce's first official quarterly [earnings release](https://investor.salesforce.com/news/default.aspx) covering its Q3 FY 2027, expected to be released in December 2026.
questions.fine_print: Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution.
